english.title: Implant a microchip in a dog when unqualified - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) implanted a microchip in a dog, namely **(..IDENTIFY DOG..), without complying with the requirements of regulation 10(1) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023, in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(1) and 14(2)(b) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
not being a person identified in regulation 10(1)(a), (b) or (c)
implanted a microchip in a dog

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For offences committed before 16th May 2023 see H12560.
(ii) For the offence in relation to cats see H101338.
